Synopsis

Installers for Notezilla, RecentX, and Copywhiz, from conceptworld.com, were compromised. Trojanized installers executed malware stealing browser credentials, crypto wallets, clipboard/keystrokes, and downloading more payloads. Rapid7 discovered the compromise, and Conceptworld remediated it within 12 hours of disclosure.
